static_traits.name: Zhang Chenyu
static_traits.medical_history: Always shy in character; never received psychotherapy or treatment for psychological problems; without significant physical illness.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, acceptable cooperation; negative and hesitant tone, frequent Self-denial and self-blame; thinking shows negative filtering, personalization and all-or-nothing labeling tendencies.

basic_info.main_problem: Extreme shyness, especially intense stress and panic when singing in front of others, leading to missing the audition, followed by persistent sense of worthlessness and self-blame.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing extreme shyness and negative self-talk are blocking my love for singing and goal pursuit, hoping to not miss opportunities again and learn to view self and experiences constructively.
growth_experiences: Always shy in character, but never had such extreme self-blame and sense of worthlessness before; never received psychological counseling or treatment for psychological problems, and without significant physical illness.

core_beliefs: Being harshly judged and ridiculed in front of others

special_situations.event: Unable to show up on audition day due to extreme stress and panic
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perform perfectly on key occasions, it means I am a failure/a useless person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids being judged and failing by avoiding attending events and reducing performance opportunities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Not going to the audition proves I am a useless person

special_situations.event: Thinking about singing in front of everyone and being watched and judged by the audience
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others will stare at me harshly and wait for me to err; any mistake will be negated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids singing in public and avoids new showcase opportunities to reduce the chance of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are all waiting for me to embarrass myself

special_situations.event: Whenever considering new opportunities to showcase singing talent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail again it further proves I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitation and procrastination, fewer attempts to avoid experiencing failure and shame again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up again; better not to go

special_situations.event: Recalls missing the audition and persistently focuses on its negative impact
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: This failure is enough to define my overall worth; other aspects do not matter
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly ruminates on negative details, ignoring any neutral or positive aspects
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just a failure, with nothing redeeming

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and recognized, to display oneself and one's talents in front of others at ease
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being harshly judged and shamed by others, being negated and belittled for performance mistakes
defense_goal: Through avoidance and self-belittling, reduces the risk of being judged, maintaining superficial safety

object_relations.self_representation: A worthless performer prone to failure
object_relations.object_representation: Picky audience/others waiting for him to make a mistake

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes breaking the problem down and making an action plan
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing this method is ineffective for oneself, 'no use thinking about it', maintaining the status quo with rational reasons (skeptical of change)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a tactful, hesitant tone, expressing doubt with 'I am not sure/maybe/possibly'; fewer concrete commitments, avoiding deep emotions.

manifestations: Lacking Social support and someone to confide in when facing shyness and Self-denial
Having no one to turn to in difficult situations, bearing panic and self-blame alone
outcomes: Reinforcing the sense of worthlessness and Self-denial

manifestations: Treating one missed audition as the core basis for self-worth
outcomes: Weakened motivation to pursue goals and behavioral avoidance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and self-deprecation ('I am a useless person' 'failure')
Being overly cautious when trying new opportunities, indecisive, limiting actions

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing 'they are all waiting for me to make a fool of myself', attributing the inner experience of shame and fear to others' judgment
Before singing in public, presumes others' negative views and thus avoids

positive_force: Has passion for singing and awareness of pursuing goals
Has proactively sought counseling help; has motivation to change
Willing to try breaking down problems and practicing cognitive restructuring
negative_force: Extreme shyness and strong fear of others' judgments
Negative cognitive biases (all-or-nothing, mental filtering, personalization, mind reading/predicting the future)
Persistent self-blame and self-labeling lead to low self-esteem
Avoidant behaviors cause lost opportunities and reinforce negative beliefs
Lacking a Social support system, having no one to turn to when in difficulty

target_behavior.behavior: When facing public singing/audition scenes, panic appears and one avoids and is absent
antecedent: Thinking about singing in front of others
Anticipating being harshly judged by the audience
Extreme pressure on audition day, triggering panic
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being judged and embarrassed in front of others, catastrophizing failure with all-or-nothing Interpretation
target_behavior.function: Escaping high Anxiety and the threat of being negated, seeking short-term security
target_behavior.consequence: Missing performance and development opportunities, reinforcing the 'worthless/failure' self-belief, further worsening avoidance and emotional problems

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly blaming oneself and describing oneself with negative labels like 'useless' 'failure'
antecedent: When sensing possible judgment from others
target_behavior.core_reason: Self-evaluation driven by negative cognitive biases (mental filtering, all-or-nothing thinking, personalization), avoiding further risks and failures through self-deprecation
target_behavior.function: Maintaining avoidance and a surface sense of control through self-punishment and deprecation, reducing action pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem and self-efficacy decrease, emotions worsen, further reducing attempts and participation, forming a vicious cycle
